content: Retention policy shapes in comparable systems: IPFS Kubo uses pin-set mark-sweep GC (ipfs repo gc) with size watermark config (StorageMax/StorageGCWatermark) - size-based protection plus explicit pins; s3d bounds pending-upload staging disk with sia.diskUsageLimit (default 10 GiB, 0=disabled) and an uploadDeadline (24h) age trigger; SuperGenius already ships a dual-shape result-cache GC (GeniusNode.cpp StartResultGC/RunResultGC): age-based result_retention_hours (default 168h, 0=keep forever) AND size cap result_retention_max_mb (0=no cap), file mtime-sorted oldest-first eviction with bitswap_->unpersistBlock(cid), timer at max(1, retention/10) hours plus a 30s initial pass. Age+size dual trigger is the table-stakes shape; pin/hold exceptions (s3d snapshots withhold objects from cleanup) are the differentiator.
